newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC stocks closes firmer in buying mood.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC stocks closes firmer in buying mood.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed up on Thursday, with most blue chips ending firmer under buying pressure, traders said.
Operators predicted the market would post further gains on Friday, with particular interest in refineries and cement makers.
Two of three independent indices which measure the performance of the OTC market on the basis of average prices and market capitalisation, rose on Thursday.
The VAB-RA all-share index, computed by Vanguard Securities, was 3.6 percent up from Wednesday at 5,848.1 points and Creditanstalt Securities' CAS-RQ gained 4.07 percent to 1,037 points.
The BIG OTC index was not immediately available.
Gainers outnumbered losers by 177 to 83. The 227 remaining listed companies were unchanged.
Petromidia refinery closed up 1,500 lei at 38,500, while Arpechim, another oil refinery, firmed 1,000 lei to 51,000. Cement maker Romcim went up 2,750 lei to 52,750.
Steel mill Sidex went up 1,500 lei to 22,500 and traders forecast further gains. They said the Sidex might clear 23,500 on Friday or early next week.
Overall turnover rose on Thursday to 28.17 billion lei from 23.9 billion on Wednesday.
